During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''mission''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|That'll bring the city's security forces down here sooner than planned. That's fine with me&hellip; the more attention this gets, the sooner this planet will join the Separatist movement.|[[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]], to Banks|<ref name="TEW" />}}
[[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] led a mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]], ostensibly to shut down a [[Oznek power plant|droid command center]]. The mission, however, was a plot by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Griebs Kishpaugh]] and Banks's fellow [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], [[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]], to embroil the strategic planet and its native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Toma]], in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] and allow both men to defect to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]]. Throughout the mission, Banks lost his [[Banks's squadron|squadron]] to both the enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and the treachery of Ghost. Nevertheless, Banks managed to foil the plot, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Ghost and arresting Kishpaugh.<ref name="TEW" />
